title: memzero_explicit throughout: correct, do not simplify
description: All key-holding buffers are zeroed with memzero_explicit(), not memset(). The compiler is legally permitted to elide memset() when the buffer goes out of scope with no subsequent reads. memzero_explicit() is a compiler barrier. A reviewer who suggests replacing it with memset() or bzero() to 'clean it up' is wrong. FIPS 140-3 requires zeroization; memset() is not guaranteed to satisfy that requirement.
close_reason: Decision recorded. memzero_explicit used throughout — no code change needed.
